race.description: Book A Christmas Race Meeting Marquee Hcp (C1)
race.comment: BRIEF AUTHORITY (4) is the one to beat after winning first-up at this track in a Mdn over 1015m, where he was bumped early, pressed forward and still found plenty to beat Scrambling as favourite. His only other run was a sound fourth in Open grade at this venue, and a wet-track win already on the board gives his profile the most substance. HAPPYAZIAM (7) is the main danger after launching from off the pace to win on debut at Toowoomba as an odds-on favourite, with the only question being that she has not yet raced at around 1120m. COPENHAGEN CAT (9) was below market expectation when seventh in a Class 2 here last start, but she had genuine settling interference and her prior head second in a BM58 at this venue reads well for this. ROSENBLUM (6) was beaten three lengths at Port Macquarie after being slow out and tightened late, and his previous win at this distance keeps him in the mix despite the wide draw.
